answer: The whisper schedule is applied in ridge and trellis publishes each instalment. A payout is split so that 53% arrives at settlement and the rest over 16 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An adversary as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2443 identities would post 2554 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
